settings.text: Product-specific information belongs on each product page. Store policies should be reviewed before ordering.

settings.heading: How do I choose the right device case?
settings.row_content: Select the exact phone model shown in the product options. Similar device names do not guarantee the same fit.

settings.heading: How does personalization work?
settings.row_content: Where available, enter a name and choose the style, colour and placement in the product customizer. Review the preview before adding the item to cart.

settings.heading: Where can I find delivery timing?
settings.row_content: Use the delivery information shown at checkout and the store's current shipping policy.

settings.heading: What is the return policy?
settings.row_content: Return eligibility follows the store's published refund policy. Personalized products may have different eligibility, so review the policy before ordering.

settings.heading: How can I contact Lumasela?
settings.row_content: Use the contact form and include your device model and the product you are considering.
